targets.title: Feeling the future: Experimental evidence for anomalous retroactive influences on cognition and affect.
targets.evidence_quote: Bem's Experiments 8 and 9 involved an alleged retroactive facilitation of recall. The current study reports three pre-registered, independent attempts to replicate the ninth experiment, which was chosen for two reasons.
targets.outcome_quote: While Bem found a substantial effect, our results failed to provide any evidence for retroactive facilitation of recall.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors give an overall failure verdict for all three close replications.

reasoning: New participants in three independent laboratories re-test Experiment 9 of the cited published paper. Other references are background, methods, or earlier attempts rather than targets.
